answer.rationale: The incumbent will not meet the mandated 18% spend reduction, while the low-cost vendor's quote does. With expiry in 14 days and no auto-renewal, switching is currently the only identified path that satisfies the cost mandate. However, the 94% committed-volume line load means delivery continuity is a critical unverified risk: prior memory supports rapid onboarding and accurate invoicing, but does not establish capacity, quality, or on-time delivery performance at this volume. Verify memory_c2 before commitment and make the switch conditional on confirmed supply capacity and transition readiness.
